title: artifact_emit meta: experiment-dashboard
description: meta for artifact type 'experiment-dashboard'. path: project-relative results.json (experiments/results.json): {status, plannedCount, currentExperiment, baseline, successThreshold, experiments[], and for autonomous research mode:"autonomous-research" constraints, costAccounting, convergence}. The file is watched; rewriting it updates the panel.

panel_id.description: Stable panel id; re-emitting with the same panel_id updates the panel in place and `close` with it removes it. Defaults to a hash of (type, path).

branch.description: AR fan-out branch slug, if any.
